newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all steady, activity thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all steady, activity thin.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly steady on Wednesday, traders said.
Naphtha remained weak as end-users stayed out of the market.
Gasoline drifted off early highs made on the back of a U.S draw and hedging.
High sulphur fuel oil was stable and barges traded at $90 fob ARA. Low sulphur fuel oil was stable but bearish supplies loomed from across the Atlantic.
Gas oil barge premiums were about 50 cents stronger, but weaker IPE futures wiped out any potential gains.
